The '''LCS 2022 Summer''' was the second split of the 2022 [[League of Legends Championship Series]] season, organized by Riot Games. It took place from June 18 to September 11, 2022, with the Regular Season held at the LCS Studio in Los Angeles, United States, and the Finals at the United Center in Chicago, United States. Ten franchised teams competed in a Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}} Group Stage, followed by a Double Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} Playoff bracket. The total prize pool was $200,000 USD. The top three teams from the split qualified for the [[World Championship/2022|2022 World Championship]].

Ahead of the 2022 Summer season, it was announced that {{player|Summit|pos=top}} and {{player|Winsome|pos=sup}} would leave [[Cloud9]]. They announced on May 11th that {{player|Fudge|pos=mid}} roleswapped back to top lane while {{player|Jensen|pos=mid}} will return to midlane after a split hiatus on the sidelines and that {{player|Zven|pos=bot}} will take over the support role. <ref name="C9 Roster">{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/C9LoL/status/1524559167746367489?s=20&t=WmhjG8BYLNfcs9I9A780XA|title=The Systems Have Decided.|date=2022-05-11 |author=[[Cloud9]] |publisher=Twitter |language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref> {{player|Stixxay|pos=bot}} also returned to the LCS, leaving [[Golden Guardians]]' coaching staff to become their botlaner once again, replacing {{player|Lost|pos=bot}}. <ref name="Stixxay to starter">{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/GoldenGuardians/status/1526664649055170562 |title=Join us in welcoming the legend, @Stixxay, back to the Rift as our LCS ADC! |date=2022-05-17 |author=[[Golden Guardians]] |publisher=Twitter |language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>

During the season, several rosters would go through changes. [[TSM]] announced that they would bring in {{player|Soul|link=Soul (Canadian player)|pos=top}}, {{player|Instinct|link=Instinct (American player)|pos=bot}} and {{player|Chime|pos=sup}} to their starting roster, later on promoting {{player|Solo|pos=top}} to replace {{player|Soul|link=Soul (Canadian player)|pos=top}}. {{player|Huni|pos=top}} retired during the season, due to wrist issues. <ref name="Huni retires">{{cite web |url=https://www.reddit.com/r/TeamSolomid/comments/vxiqba/lcs_and_academy_roster_updates |title=LCS and Academy Roster Updates |date=2022-07-12 |author=[[Glen]] |publisher=Reddit |language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref> [[Dignitas]] announced a mid-season roster shuffle too, promoting academy players {{player|Hoon|pos=top}}, {{player|Exyu|pos=jg}} and {{player|Spawn|link=Spawn (Canadian player)|pos=bot}} from their academy roster, simultaneously selling {{player|River|link=River (Korean player)|pos=jg}} to [[Golden Guardians]].<ref name="River to DIG">{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/GoldenGuardians/status/1552087709501386752|title=We're ready to make another run for LCS Finals, and we're bringing in a little extra help to do so!|date=2022-07-26 |author=[[Golden Guardians]] |publisher=Twitter |language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref><ref name="dig midseason shuffle">{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/DignitasLoL/status/1552700576055455744 |title=See you on Saturday #LCS |date=2022-07-28 |author=[[Dignitas]] |publisher=Twitter |language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>

==Format==
* '''Group Stage''' - ''June 17<sup>th</sup> - August 14<sup>th</sup>, 2022''
** Double Round Robin
** Each team plays 18 matches.
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}
**1st to 8th place will play the Playoffs
***1st and 2nd place are seeded into Semifinals
***3rd to 6th place are seeded into Upper Bracket Quarterfinals
***7th and 8th place are seeded into Lower Bracket Round 1

* '''Playoffs ''' - ''August 20<sup>th</sup> - September 11<sup>th</sup>, 2022''
** Double Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Top 3 teams qualify for [[World Championship/2022|World Championship 2022]]
